description: This Java source file defines the GceService class, which extends Android's Service class. It manages system events related to network connectivity, Bluetooth state, and configuration changes, and handles foreground notifications. The service is started at system boot and responds to specific intents to perform configuration or status updates. It also includes methods for registering broadcast receivers, handling configuration changes, and dumping internal state for debugging.

classes.name: GceService
classes.description: Android Service managing system events, notifications, and configuration changes related to the Cuttlefish virtual device environment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, registers broadcast receivers, sets up system state, and creates notification channels.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used in this service.

methods.name: registerBroadcastReceivers
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for connectivity and Bluetooth state changes.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Determines the current display rotation in degrees.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles display configuration changes, reporting screen size, density, and rotation.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to perform configuration or status updates, and starts the service in the foreground.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receivers upon service destruction.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs internal state and system service statuses for debugging.
